# Variable font fixture

`InterVariable.ttf` is the unchanged TrueType variable font of Inter 4.1
(`docs/font-files/InterVariable.ttf` at tag `v4.1` of
https://github.com/rsms/inter, commit
`e3a3d4c57d5ecc01453a575621882a384c1995a3`), 879,708 bytes, SHA-256
`4989b125924991b90d05b2d16e0e388c48f7d5bb8b30539bbf9c755278d0ccaf`.

It is the proportional variable font of the test suite: its axes are `wght`
(100 to 900, default 400) and `opsz` (14 to 32, default 14), and its advance
widths change with the weight, which the monospaced Source Code Pro variable
font cannot show.

The file is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 in `OFL.txt` and
is not included in the npm package.
